name: AT-LS
description: Integrates Drupal with the AT-LS translation service via an advanced-queue workflow.
project_description:
This module provides an integration with AT-LS translate service to create or update our translatable entities.

 Installation 
 Install as usual, see Installing Modules or Installing modules' Composer dependencies for further information.

 Configuration 
 Before configuring this module, it is necessary to map the languages and create

the necessary API keys:

 
 Go to admin/config/services/at-ls/languages and maps AT-LS languages(ISO 639-2) with our Drupal installation langcodes. 
 Go to admin/config/system/keys and add the keys for your AT-LS API key/s. 
 
 Then we can go to the configuration page admin/config/services/at-ls/settings

 Finally, go to the mappings page `admin/config/services/at-ls/mappings` to set the translatable entities and fields.
